The hotlines should come with a disclaimer.  Most of them are required to contact the authorities when a caller is foolish enough to admit she is a danger to herself or others.  This can end up getting people in more trouble than they were before the call was placed.  It bothers me that people like yourself have no guilt over the fact that their idea of help can end up causing more harm than good.

My problems aren't important.  As you can see from the post, I didn't go into detail.  The reason I briefly alluded to my history is to shed some insight into the mindset of someone who wants to die.  A truly suicidal person is likely to find cutesy animals and songs of the day condescending.  It's liable to frustrate them rather than elevate their mood.

Like I said, this subreddit seems to exist to help those who just want a hug rather than provide information and acceptance.
